title: Track a generator for the embedded UI SPIR-V header
body: The tracked UiShaderSpirv.g.h describes packing glslc outputs with a script, but no generator existed in the repository. I added libraries/RenderGraph/src/Ui/shaders/regenerate-ui-shader-header.py to compile both UI shaders and regenerate that header; promote this into the supported generated-artifact workflow so renderer shader changes stay reproducible.

title: Align msdfgen’s Windows CRT with VIXEN
body: The documented native capture command bash reports/capturespeed/reproduce/native-capture.sh lookdev midday failed while linking vixen_lookdev_capture.exe because msdfgen-core used MT_StaticRelease and VIXEN used MD_DynamicRelease (LNK2038). I set MSDFGEN_DYNAMIC_RUNTIME=ON for MSVC in VIXEN/dependencies/CMakeLists.txt; make the dependency composition select the consumer CRT automatically so new FetchContent libraries do not need per-library hand wiring.

title: Provide a dependency-free PNG pixel-diff tool for capture evidence
body: The lane needed changed-pixel counts, max channel delta, and crops for the mandatory native/Dozen HUD comparison. Python lacked both NumPy and Pillow and no ImageMagick/ffmpeg command was installed, so I wrote a one-off standard-library PNG decoder/encoder under the external evidence directory. Add a repository capture-diff helper or declare and verify its runtime dependency so capture lanes can produce these acceptance metrics consistently.
